text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! How atmospheric.

One day, after winning countless races 
with Buena Vista, we went on a trip using 
the hot spring voucher I had won at the 
raffle.

To show our gratitude for everything they 
do, Buena Vista's parents were supposed to 
stay at the inn together with us, but...
choice_data_list:
Around what time is your mom and the 
others coming?

Around what time is your mom and the 
others coming?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it'll be late at night. Let's 
look around plenty until then!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Look! It says it's a rubber ducky that 
floats in the bath.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And she has such fluttery eyelashes and 
sparkly eyes! So cute~!
choice_data_list: You look a lot like Buena, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Is this really how you see me, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Hehe... Because they're ducks♪

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you like it? It's our original mascot 
here.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
These are not-for-sale items made for 
promotional use, but... Here, young lady, 
take one with you!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
When she looks at me with such sparkling 
eyes... I just want to do anything and 
everything for her.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, thank you very much! I'll 
shower it with tons of love!

The shopkeeper watches warmly as Buena 
Vista browses the storefront for a 
souvenir. Everyone who comes in contact 
with her ends up feeling the exact same 
way—
choice_data_list:
(A gentle desire to cherish and protect 
them...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Another ducky here! ...Is this the 
plain version?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
......I know! Let's get that girl from 
earlier a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's not it... It's about you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We're going to be together forever. Duck 
Buena-san needs Duck Trainer-san by her 
side, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it's decided! Duck Trainer, come 
over to my house♪

After exploring the hot spring town with 
Buena Vista until the sun went down, we 
headed toward the inn—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a nice bath.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Need a little... break...

I lie down on my back next to Buena Vista, 
who is already sprawled out on the ground. 
Looking up, the view outside the window 
catches my eye—
choice_data_list: Look, there are so many stars.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right...! ...Fufu, it's pretty 
even upside down—

Right then, at the exact same moment, we 
turned to face each other—and our eyes 
drew closer. Deep within them, countless 
stars seemed to twinkle...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Maybe that was... a little 
ill-mannered of me.
choice_data_list:
There's no one else here, so it should be 
fine, right?
Nobody else is around, so why not?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you have a Trainer, don't you?
choice_data_list: I'm basically like family to you, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's how important of a presence 
they are. There's no doubt about that, 
right? But...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind showing you my pathetic 
side. But I never want to show you a 
half-hearted one."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I can show my weak side. But... I never 
want to show an uncute side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's totally different. You really 
are...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A precious and irreplaceable neighbor. The 
closest, yet the furthest... my childhood 
friend.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, even if we weren't childhood 
friends... would you have found me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Did you come to love my running... and aim 
for that breathtaking view with me, I 
wonder?

—Because no matter who looks, when, or 
where... it is an "unforgettable sight" 
that captivates all. Just as I was about 
to say that...

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that room over there? Thank you for 
showing me the way.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like Mom and the others are 
finally here. I guess our time alone 
together ends here."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Shh... —It's okay, I understand.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Buena Vista...
